name: ESAF Small Finance Bank Limited

timeline.x: [General Updates] ESAF Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of Communication from ESAF Financial Holdings Private Limited (EFHPL), the Promoter Company of the Bank, on NCLT Sanction of the Revised Scheme of Arrangement.
